info.name: EvolvIQ — API
info.description: Run top-to-bottom with the Collection Runner. Requires the bootstrap Platform Admin and demo schools (npm run db:seed-dev). Change {{run}} to a new value for each run so emails/IDs/class names stay unique. JWTs are never hard-coded — they are captured from login requests into collection variables, as are the ids later folders use. Folders: 1–4 auth & registration, 5 schools, 6 logout, 7 users, 8 parent ↔ student links, 9 classes, 10 activity library, 11 observations & review, 12 assignments & completions, 13 progress. Folders 6–13 depend on the accounts created in folders 2–4.

item.name: Teacher tries to register a student → 403
5 · Schools (Platform Admin)
item.description: School management: Platform Admin writes, Psychologists list, everyone else views only their own school. Uses {{platformToken}} (folder 1) and, for the 403 checks, {{teacherToken}} / {{schoolAdminToken}} (folders 3–4). Run after folders 1–4.

6 · Session (logout)
item.description: POST /auth/logout ends the caller's current session: the presented refresh token and every token rotated from it are revoked. Other sessions stay signed in; the access token expires on its own. Also captures {{teacherId}} for later folders.

request.description: Every role may log out. Revokes this session only.
A refresh token can only end its own owner's session.

item.name: 7 · Users (Platform Admin, School Admin)
item.description: List / view / edit / deactivate / reactivate. Platform Admins manage everyone; School Admins only students, teachers and parents of their own school (anyone else → 404). Nobody can deactivate or reactivate themselves. Also captures the ids and tokens the workflow folders use.

item.name: List users — Platform Admin, teachers of School A

exec: pm.test("only School A teachers", () => b.users.forEach((u) => { pm.expect(u.role).to.eql("teacher"); pm.expect(u.schoolId).to.eql(pm.variables.get("schoolAId")); }));

item.name: List users — School Admin sees only own-school students/teachers/parents

exec: pm.test("own school, managed roles only", () => pm.response.json().users.forEach((u) => { pm.expect(u.schoolId).to.eql(pm.variables.get("schoolAId")); pm.expect(["student", "teacher", "parent"]).to.include(u.role); }));

item.name: List users — School Admin, another school → 403
View user — School Admin views their student
View user — School Admin, a psychologist (out of reach) → 404

request.description: Adults: fullName, email. Students: fullName, studentId. Role and school never change.

item.name: Edit user — student gets an email → 400

exec: pm.test("names the field", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.details).to.eql([{ field: "email", message: "is not allowed for students" }]));

item.name: Edit user — role / school are immutable → 400

exec: pm.test("both rejected", () => { const f = pm.response.json().error.details.map((d) => d.field); pm.expect(f).to.include("role"); pm.expect(f).to.include("schoolId"); });

item.name: Deactivate — School Admin deactivates own-school teacher

request.description: Also revokes all of the user's refresh tokens.

exec: pm.test("message", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.message).to.eql("You cannot deactivate your own account."));

item.name: 8 · Parent ↔ student links
item.description: A parent has many children; a student has one parent; both in the same school. Platform Admin and School Admin (own school) link / unlink; parents list their own children.

item.name: Register — second student, no parent (saves student2Id)
Register — third student, no parent or class (saves student3Id)

exec: pm.test("one parent per student", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.message).to.eql("This student already has a parent."));

item.name: Link a School B parent to a School A student → 422
List links — Parent sees only their own children
9 · Classes (School Admin)
item.description: A class belongs to the School Admin's school (taken from the token), has only a name (unique per school, any case → 409), many teachers, and students who each belong to one class. Teachers see only their own classes.

item.name: Create class — same name, different case → 409

exec: pm.test("schoolId not allowed", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.details).to.deep.include({ field: "schoolId", message: "is not allowed" }));

request.description: The school always comes from the token, never the body.

item.name: Add student to a second class → 409

exec: pm.test("one class per student", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.message).to.eql("This student already belongs to another class."));

item.name: List classes — Teacher sees only assigned classes
View class — Teacher sees teachers and students
View class — Teacher, a class they don't teach → 404
10 · Activity library (Psychologist)
item.description: One global library. Psychologists create, edit and archive (never delete); teachers browse. content is one of five types (one discriminated union on "type").

request.description: Single-select. No correct answer, no scoring.
Images are URLs (no upload in the MVP).

item.name: 11 · Observations & review
item.description: Teachers write about students of their classes (optional Level + learning-behaviour area); parents write about their own children under /family (those two fields → 400). Each sees only what they wrote. Psychologists review: one transaction, once (again → 409), Significant needs a development area.

item.name: Teacher writes a Significant observation (saves observationId)

body.raw:
{
  "studentId": "{{studentUserId}}",
  "area": "emotions",
  "description": "Cried at drop-off three days in a row.",
  "when": "this_week",
  "howOften": "often",
  "level": "significant",
  "learningBehaviourArea": "participation"
}

item.name: Teacher writes about a student outside their classes → 422

pm.test("developmentArea required", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.details).to.eql([{ field: "developmentArea", message: "is required for Significant observations" }]));

request.description: One API call, one database transaction: creates the recommended assignments and marks the observation reviewed.

item.name: 12 · Assignments & completions
item.description: Teachers assign directly to students of their classes (source "direct"); psychologists only through a review ("recommended"). Students answer their own assignments once. Parents see done / not done only, never answers.

item.name: Teacher assigns the text activity (saves assignmentId)
Teacher assigns to a student outside their classes → 422
Student — my assignments (saves the recommended ones)
Complete — MCQ with an option that does not exist → 400
Second student answers someone else's assignment → 404

exec: pm.test("answer visible to staff", () => pm.expect(a.completion.answer).to.eql({ type: "text", text: "I helped my friend at lunch." }));

item.name: Parent — child's activities: done / not done only

exec: pm.test("done flags", () => { pm.expect(list.find((a) => a.id === pm.variables.get("assignmentId")).isDone).to.eql(true); pm.expect(list.find((a) => a.id === pm.variables.get("ratingAssignmentId")).isDone).to.eql(false); });

item.name: 13 · Progress
item.description: Growth areas (derived from "Assign & mark reviewed" development areas, max 5), streak (Asia/Kolkata days) and the monthly summary (template text; current month live, finished months stored and immutable). Parent-safe for every audience.

item.name: Growth areas — parent sees names only

exec: pm.test("derived from the review", () => pm.expect(g).to.deep.include({ name: "Managing feelings" }));
pm.test("at most five, names only", () => { pm.expect(g.length).to.be.at.most(5); g.forEach((x) => pm.expect(x).to.have.all.keys("name")); });
pm.test("plain template text", () => pm.expect(s.text).to.match(/^So far in /));
pm.test("month field", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.details).to.eql([{ field: "month", message: "must not be in the future" }]));
